academic.passage: The study of networks is an essential area in both science and social sciences. In natural sciences, ecosystems demonstrate how various interactions among organisms contribute to their survival and evolution. In social sciences, networks reveal the relationships and influences between individuals, communities, and institutions. Understanding these connections is crucial for tackling modern challenges such as climate change and social inequality. By analyzing networks, researchers can identify significant patterns and develop strategies that promote sustainability and social welfare.

daily.passage: Attention students: The library will be holding an extended hours program during finals week. From December 1st to December 7th, the library will remain open from 8 AM to 2 AM. We encourage all students to take advantage of this opportunity for study and research.
